item.title: Extended Reality (XR) Research and Projects
item.description: Explore my research into the intersection of emerging technologies and their impact on human-computer interaction. My work focuses on Extended Reality (XR), encompassing Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), and Mixed Reality (MR), with a particular emphasis on their application in commercial and educational contexts. Core Research Areas: 1. Digital Sovereignty in AI & XR Investigating the socio-technical implications of AI and XR, focusing on open-source infrastructure, privacy-preserving analytics, and mitigating vendor lock-in.

item.title: Research and Publications
item.description: My research focuses on the intersection of emerging technologies and their impact on digital sovereignty and human-computer interaction 🔬. Core Research Areas 📚: 1. Digital Sovereignty in the Age of AI 🛡️ Exploring the socio-technical implications of large-scale AI models and the necessity of open-source, sovereign infrastructure. Key areas include: Decentralized model training and execution 🖥️. Privacy-preserving data analytics 🔒. Mitigating vendor lock-in in critical infrastructure 🔓. 2. Immersive Educational Environments (XR) 🥽 Investigating the application of eXtended Reality (XR) for learning complex subjects like chemistry and physics.
